cards.power: ANXIETY INDUCER: force the current Quest to change
cards.lore: Late for a very important date. Possibly a hallucination. wide-eyed rabbit, melting pocket watch, fan

cards.power: THE HOOKAH HAZE: force a player to swap Actor card
cards.lore: Demands you explain who you are. Rejects your answer. blue caterpillar on mushroom, question-mark smoke

cards.power: GASLIGHT: remove a card, claim it was never there
cards.lore: We're all mad here. I'm just honest about it. pencil-sketch cat fading, huge grin

cards.power: FILIBUSTER: speak without breathing
cards.lore: Murdered time. Now lives in eternal 6:00 PM. weasel in 10/6 top hat pouring spilling tea

cards.power: FORCED TEA: force an unwanted Tool card
cards.lore: Aggressive hospitality. Takes "best butter" very seriously. frantic hare flinging teapot

cards.power: NARCOLEPSY: end the Scene
cards.lore: Breathing while sleeping is the same as sleeping while breathing. dormouse asleep inside teapot; margin "Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Bat!"

cards.power: EXECUTION: remove an Actor permanently
cards.lore: Verdict first, sentence later. OFF WITH THEIR HEADS! lioness in playing-card gown, heart scepter

cards.power: PARDON: cancel the Queen's action
cards.lore: Pardons everyone when the Queen isn't looking. tiny mouse, oversized crown over eyes

cards.power: MORALIZING: invent a nonsense rule for one round
cards.lore: Everything has a moral, if you can find it. Usually involves pepper. toad duchess holding piglet baby

cards.power: DIMENSIONAL SHIFT: describe scene as Giant or Micro
cards.lore: A cryptid ape. Changes size rapidly. Ask the Dodo for classification. TV-static girl silhouette, galaxy belly, "TOP SECRET"; pigeon shouting "SERPENT!"

cards.power: GRAVITY OPTIONAL: retrieve discarded cards as they fall
cards.lore: vortex of cupboards, clocks, marmalade jar

cards.power: SALTY: all communication while holding your nose
cards.lore: dodo and mouse in waves

cards.power: LOCKED OUT: no Quest until you solve a riddle
cards.lore: corridor of doors, golden key on glass table

cards.power: PEPPER SNEEZE: sneeze before speaking
cards.lore: flying pans in pepper smoke, Cheshire grin

cards.power: TIME LOOP: repeat the previous player's last sentence
cards.lore: long table, empty chairs, teapot

cards.power: COVER UP: overwrite a Scene card at no cost
cards.lore: white roses dripping red paint, card soldiers with brushes

cards.power: LIVE AMMO: Tools might run away
cards.lore: flamingo mallets, hedgehog balls

cards.power: KANGAROO COURT: logic forbidden; if a story makes sense, call "Blödsinn!"
cards.lore: jury box of animals with slates; guinea pig in sack "(suppressed)"

cards.power: MELANCHOLY: tell all stories with a deep, heavy sigh
cards.lore: weeping calf-headed turtle on sea rock

cards.power: GROW: Actor becomes Giant, can intimidate the King
cards.lore: "EAT ME" cake

cards.power: SHRINK: Actor becomes Micro, hides inside other cards
cards.lore: "DRINK ME" bottle

cards.power: MUTATION: coin flip; heads grow, tails shrink, edge: neck like a serpent
cards.lore: bitten red fly agaric

cards.power: BLUNT FORCE: "strike" a conversation, change topic
cards.lore: grumpy flamingo with baseball bat

cards.power: ANNOYANCE: force a player to write instead of speak
cards.lore: slate reading "SCREECH"

cards.power: STICKY TRAP: Actor cannot leave the Scene
cards.lore: treacle pit, teapot and bowler stuck; "Humbug!"
Goal: conceal a mistake before the Queen arrives. Risk: decapitation. paint bucket over white roses
Goal: help the White Rabbit find his accessories. Risk: mistaken for housemaid 'Mary Ann'. pair of white gloves
Goal: answer "Why is a raven like a writing desk?" Risk: no answer, infinite loop. raven on writing desk
Goal: prove innocence (or guilt). Risk: the Knave is guilty, but the evidence is a poem that makes no sense. tray of heart tarts, card-Knave running
Goal: recite a poem correctly. Risk: words come out wrong ("Twinkle Twinkle Little Bat"). lectern, scroll of "Twinkle Twinkle Little Bat"
